PLAN "Deload Week - Post Hypertrophy"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS
  GOAL primary strength:
    name "Recovery and readiness"

PHASES
  PHASE "Deload" (1 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Monday training 45m "Upper - Push/Pull Deload":
        warmup:
          rowing 8m
        main straight_sets:
          bench_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          incline_press 2x6 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          barbell_row 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          face_pull 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          chest_stretch 6m
      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Lower Deload":
        warmup:
          cycling 8m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 2x6 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          leg_press 2x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          calf_raise 2x12 rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          hamstring_stretch 6m
      DAY Friday training 50m "Full Body Light":
        warmup:
          rowing 6m
        main straight_sets:
          deadlift 2x4 rpe 6 rest 180 seconds
          overhead_press 3x5 rpe 6 rest 120 seconds
          pull_up 3x4 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          plank 3x30s rpe 6 rest 60 seconds
        cooldown:
          back_stretch 6m
      DAY Saturday training 30m "Mobility & Active Recovery":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2x60s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          quad_stretch 2x60s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          pigeon_pose 2x60s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
          thoracic_mobility 2x60s rpe 6 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 6m
